en: An old monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of an industrial complex in a rural landscape with forested hills behind it. Several large factory and residential buildings are visible, along with a tall smokestack emitting smoke. A railway or road runs in front of the complex. At the bottom is a white margin with printed captions and extensive handwritten text in a cursive script.
